name: Gloaming-Null
description: Gloaming-Null is an airless barren world of featureless plains interrupted only by impact craters and a single exposed metallic core fragment that juts from the surface like a dark tooth. The absence of atmosphere leaves the surface exposed to the full spectrum of stellar radiation, bleaching the rock to a uniform grey.

Without air to scatter light, the transition from day to night is abrupt and total. The gloaming is measured in seconds rather than minutes, a razor-thin band where the shadows of surface features stretch to infinity before winking out entirely as the terminator passes.

The exposed core fragment suggests this world was once much larger, stripped of its outer layers by a catastrophic collision or tidal disruption. The remaining body is dense and mineral-rich, its composition more typical of a planetary interior than a surface.

The platinum and titanium concentrations in the core fragment are exceptional, making Gloaming-Null a high-priority mining target. The absence of atmosphere simplifies extraction logistics, and the low gravity reduces launch costs for ore transport to orbit.
